preconditions.description: Number of cities is between 2 and 200.
Number of roads is between 1 and 50,000.
Price of one gold coin in tugriks is between 1 and 10^9.
Price of one silver coin in tugriks is between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= N and 1 <= yi <= N and 1 <= gi <= 10**9 and 1 <= si <= 10**9 for xi, yi, gi, si in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two valid cities and has valid gold and silver requirements.

postconditions.description: The output is either the minimal cost of the gift or '<image>' if no valid gift exists.

postconditions.expression: all(gi <= min_gold and si <= min_silver for gi, si in road_requirements)
postconditions.description: The chosen gold and silver coins satisfy all road requirements.
The minimal cost is calculated correctly based on the chosen gold and silver coins.
